cards.claim: Marijke Lagerlöf has been listed on the focus list for the NL Gendergap maintenance project.
cards.quote: This is where the NL Gendergap maintenance project comes into play. Launched by a group of dedicated Wikipedians, this initiative aims to bridge the gender gap on the Dutch-language Wikipedia by creating and improving articles about notable women. The project's focus list, a curated selection of individuals who have made significant contributions to their respective fields, features none other than Marijke Lagerlöf. Evidence of Lagerlöf's inclusion on the focus list can be found on the project's Wikipedia page, where her name appears alongside other trailblazing women from the Netherlands.

raw_card.claim: Marijke Lagerlöf has been listed on the focus list for WikiProject Badminton/tournament focus list.
